nodes.label: add.sv (source file)
nodes.rationale: SystemVerilog source attached to the project; 'U' badge is the git untracked decoration.

nodes.label: Files Tree View (sidebar)
nodes.rationale: Sidebar tree listing the open project file as root and its HDL source files as children; toolbar actions sit in the view title bar.

nodes.label: Project File (untitled:add.digitaljs)
nodes.rationale: Unsaved (untitled:) project shown as tree root; pre-1.0 .digitaljs extension, same JSON content as today's .hdls.

nodes.label: Files Side Panel Screenshot
nodes.rationale: Annotated README screenshot (red labels) explaining the Files tree view toolbar. Predates 1.0: the activity bar container is still titled DIGITALJS and the project is untitled:add.digitaljs; 1.0 renamed projects to .hdls.

nodes.label: Enable wire curling into a loop at the Tribuf en port (routing bug)
nodes.norm_label: enable wire curling into a loop at the tribuf en port (routing bug)

nodes.label: Tribuf cell (tristate buffer: in, out, enable on bottom)
nodes.norm_label: tribuf cell (tristate buffer: in, out, enable on bottom)

nodes.label: hdlstudio serve (JSON-lines engine protocol)
nodes.rationale: One per circuit view; 10 ms slices, update every 25 ms, cells addressed by path.

nodes.label: Engine restart does not reload circuit
nodes.norm_label: engine restart does not reload circuit

nodes.label: Interval mode (skip empty ticks)
nodes.rationale: Works out ticks owed since last slice and jumps to target tick so empty ticks cost nothing; backlog is dropped.

nodes.label: LuaRunner (view/lua_runner.ts)
nodes.rationale: One Lua execution at a time; running one stops others and the REPL queues inputs.

nodes.label: hdlstudio engine (Rust binary)
nodes.rationale: Native process so the vsix is per platform; no web (vscode.dev) build.

nodes.label: hdlstudio-sim (event-driven simulator)
nodes.rationale: Per-cell propagation delays, per-tick event queue, flattened hierarchy, lazy input copies; zero-delay loop that never settles is an error.

nodes.label: Lua engine in hdlstudio (mlua, Lua 5.4)
nodes.rationale: Scripts are coroutines; sim.sleep/sim.wait register an alarm/monitor and yield, removing cross-thread races of the JS engine.

nodes.label: sim.registerdisplay in Lua
nodes.rationale: Number formats live in the view, so it needs an engine-view protocol.

nodes.label: Simulator speed improvements
nodes.rationale: Fold zero-delay BusSlice/BusGroup cells into readers (a third of evaluations) and a narrow-value fast path for nets up to 64 bits.

nodes.label: Wide index and shift-amount saturation
nodes.rationale: yosys keeps index widths; engine saturates shift amounts and treats out-of-range addresses as x.

nodes.label: cells.ts (cell geometry and drawing)
nodes.rationale: Keeps pre-1.0 geometry so saved layouts still fit.

nodes.label: Layout stored in circuit (position/vertices)
nodes.rationale: A showcircuit whose netlist didn't change only redraws, so undo/redo of a move keeps simulating.

nodes.label: Board Top-Level Schematic (clk/rst -> sys -> panel -> matrix)
nodes.norm_label: board top-level schematic (clk/rst -> sys -> panel -> matrix)

nodes.label: Watched Signals: clk, rst, matrix, col_data
nodes.norm_label: watched signals: clk, rst, matrix, col_data

nodes.label: Waveform Monitor Panel (Signal/Value/waveform, ms ruler, dark theme)
nodes.norm_label: waveform monitor panel (signal/value/waveform, ms ruler, dark theme)

nodes.label: Waveform Toolbar (zoom in/out, fit, follow simulation)
nodes.norm_label: waveform toolbar (zoom in/out, fit, follow simulation)

nodes.label: Live Wire Value Colouring (green=1, red=0, blue=bus)
nodes.norm_label: live wire value colouring (green=1, red=0, blue=bus)

nodes.label: LEDMatrix widget
nodes.rationale: Width alone is ambiguous (4x4 vs 2x8), so rows/cols come from port attributes on the netnames wire.

nodes.label: build_yosys_script (src/yosys_script.mjs)
nodes.rationale: vscode-free so tests can import it.

nodes.label: hdlstudio-yosys (yosys JSON to circuit converter)
nodes.rationale: Reproduces the original converter's quirks on purpose (device numbering, $_DFF_P_ Map typo); semantic changes go in their own commits.

nodes.label: test:pipeline (pipeline.spec.mjs)
nodes.rationale: Named .spec.mjs so the electron glob ignores it.

nodes.label: techmap excludes flip-flops/latches/memories
nodes.rationale: Bare techmap lowers them to gate-level primitives the converter can't convert, giving Invalid cell type.

nodes.label: Control panel
nodes.rationale: Does all time-tick conversion; circuit view and engine only see ticks.

nodes.label: Timescale (tick to time units)
nodes.rationale: document.setTimescale fires synthOptionUpdated, otherwise the Synthesis panel writes its stale copy back.

nodes.label: inout port split (inout.rs)
nodes.rationale: Output P__out carries only the module's own drivers; exporting the resolved value causes an x = merge(x, z) loop that latches the last bus value.

nodes.label: readmem data file basename alias (data_file_paths)
nodes.rationale: Sources are flattened into the synthesis dir, so a bare filename only resolves through the alias.

nodes.label: Release 1.0.0: own Rust engine replaces DigitalJS
nodes.norm_label: release 1.0.0: own rust engine replaces digitaljs

nodes.label: Run until next event (removed)
nodes.rationale: With gate delays it was a single step; replaced by One clock cycle or a waveform pause condition.

nodes.label: Waveform recording (wave.rs, watch/unwatch/wave)
nodes.rationale: wave returns one entry per pixel column so a flat-out run never streams its changes.

nodes.label: Integrated-circuit chip icon motif
nodes.rationale: Single visual identity for the extension: a microchip, matching its purpose (synthesizing SystemVerilog and simulating the resulting circuit).

nodes.label: HDL Studio activity bar icon (monochrome SVG wrapping 513px PNG raster)
nodes.norm_label: hdl studio activity bar icon (monochrome svg wrapping 513px png raster)
nodes.rationale: Monochrome variant of the chip icon for the VS Code activity bar view container (hdl-studio-container), which expects a single-colour glyph that VS Code tints with the theme. Also an SVG wrapping an embedded PNG raster rather than vector paths.

nodes.label: HDL Studio extension icon (PNG, 256px chip)
nodes.rationale: Marketplace/extension icon (package.json "icon"): a stylized integrated-circuit chip (square die with pin-1 dot, 6 pins per side, light blue fill, black outline) signalling hardware/HDL design.

nodes.label: HDL Studio command/view icon (SVG wrapping 512px PNG raster)
nodes.norm_label: hdl studio command/view icon (svg wrapping 512px png raster)
nodes.rationale: Not a true vector: an <svg> whose only content is an embedded base64 PNG (512x512) of the same chip icon. Used for command icons in package.json and the circuit view's iconPath in src/extension.mjs.
